description: Explicit printed physiology overrides creature-type defaults. Traits never come from names, damage immunities or flavour text.

traits.breath_dependent: Needs to breathe; water breathing and holding breath do not remove this need.
traits.animating_current: An equivalent animating current is explicitly permitted as a target of Empty-Lung Edict.
traits.has_body: Has a body, as stated by its printed creature record.
traits.pressure_channels: Has pressure channels, as stated by its printed creature record.
traits.exposed_airlike_current: Has an exposed supernatural airlike current, explicitly permitted for Air techniques.
traits.water_breathing: Can breathe underwater; still breath-dependent unless its printed traits say otherwise.
traits.voice_and_breath_channel: Has a meaningful mouth, throat, breath channel, or equivalent anatomy, as stated by its printed creature record. Not stated means unknown, not absent: a creature that does not need to breathe may still have such anatomy.

sources: Owner SOL94 instruction: constructs and undead do not breathe; explicit printed traits take precedence.
authority/typed_mechanics/rules_text.json: Breathless Chamber, Breath-Stealing Palm, Empty-Lung Edict, Breath Beyond the Skin.
authority/typed_mechanics/rules_text.json: Haymaker - "A creature without a meaningful mouth, throat, breath channel, or equivalent anatomy is immune."
https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary/ : holding breath does not eliminate the need to breathe.
